channel.description: New summaries and incidents confirmed by several sources in India: Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist belt.

item.title: India: Kashmir, Manipur and the Maoist belt: the situation
item.description:
Security forces and police have launched multiple search operations in Jammu and Kashmir's Poonch and Mendhar districts, while a 29-year-old woman was injured in a bear attack in the region. In Manipur, 84 BSF personnel were hospitalised with food poisoning after a morning meal, and a Kuki-Zo woman was killed and her husband wounded in an ambush by suspected Naga militants in Kamjong, leaving two civilians missing. The Cockroach movement leaders remain jailed for violating a protest-site ban, and the Cockroach protesters continue to bypass internet blackouts with Bluetooth. 437 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Machine-written from the linked sources, checked for figures and names not in them.
